meta.name: My-nutritionist system food catalog
meta.source: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central. https://fdc.nal.usda.gov
meta.license: Public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal. FoodData Central asks to be cited as the source.
meta.basis: Nutrients per 100 g of the edible portion described by usda.description.
meta.units: calories kcal; protein, carbs, fat, fiber, sugars, saturatedFat g; sodium, potassium, calcium, iron, vitaminC mg; vitaminD µg
meta.rounding: calories to the nearest kcal; other nutrients to 0.1 (half up)
meta.nullPolicy: null = USDA reports no value for this food (unknown); 0 = USDA-reported zero.

matchLevels.exact: The USDA record describes this food.
matchLevels.close: Same food with a minor difference in preparation or variety (see note).
matchLevels.proxy: No USDA record exists; the closest comparable dish is used (see note).

tagRules.takeout: fast_food items and shawarma get no rule-derived tags except vegetarian/vegan
tagRules.high_protein: protein >= 8 g/100 g and protein supplies >= 20% of energy (4 kcal/g)
tagRules.high_fiber: fiber >= 6 g/100 g (per-100 g proxy for the FDA "high" claim); not sweets
tagRules.no_cook: requiresCooking is false (eaten as bought or assembled raw)
tagRules.budget: costTier 1, excluding snacks, sweets and beverages
tagRules.condiment/alcohol: curated per food; such foods are loggable but never suggested or planned as an item

meta.allergenPolicy: Allergens list known and commonly present allergens, conservatively including brand-dependent ones (e.g. soy, sesame in buns); null when they depend entirely on the brand. Vegan/vegetarian are false when common recipes use animal-derived ingredients.
meta.maintenance: Edit this file, set meta.releasedAt to the current UTC time (never a future one: the database clamps future updated_at values), then run `npm run seed:sql` to regenerate the LATEST seed migration (see scripts/generate-seed-sql.ts). Applied migrations are never edited: a new catalog release gets a new seed migration that upserts every system food.

No generic protein-bar record in FDC. Proxy: FNDDS 'Nutrition bar (Zone Perfect Classic Crunch)' = 100% SR 'Formulated bar, ZONE PERFECT CLASSIC CRUNCH BAR, mixed flavors' (30 g protein/100 g). Brand formulas change and vary. The FNDDS 'Nutrition bar or meal replacement bar, NFS' (2708127) is a 50/50 Clif/Zone Perfect blend with 22 g protein/100 g. Allergens are left unknown because they depend on the brand (milk, soy, peanuts, tree nuts and wheat are all common); check the label.
Milk and soy listed conservatively: many bars contain milk fat or soy lecithin or carry may-contain warnings. Vegan not assumed.

usda.note: Single small patty on plain bun, no cheese. Soy and sesame are listed conservatively for the bun.
Fried in vegetable oil. Some chains add beef or dairy flavoring and share fryers with breaded items.
FNDDS 'Hummus, plain' = 100% 'Hummus, commercial' (Foundation fdcId 321358).

SR 'Falafel, home-prepared' (fried). Fiber and sugars are not reported by USDA for this record. Wheat listed because many recipes add flour. FNDDS 'Falafel' (2707408) was rejected: its recipe absorbs 224 g oil per batch (41 g fat/100 g).

No shawarma record in FDC. Proxy: FNDDS 'Gyro sandwich' (lamb+beef, tzatziki, tomato, onion, pita). Israeli shawarma is often turkey/chicken with tahini, salads and fries; values can differ substantially. Allergens cover both tzatziki (milk) and tahini (sesame).

No burekas record in FDC. Proxy: FNDDS 'Pastry, cheese-filled' (phyllo, feta, egg, margarine), which is a borek/tiropita. Israeli puff-pastry burekas are usually more energy-dense, and bakery pieces typically weigh 60-120 g, not 28 g. Sesame listed because Israeli burekas are often topped with seeds. The 100 g bakery-piece serving is a typical Israeli bakery size, not a USDA portion.
No shakshuka record in FDC. Proxy: FNDDS 'Huevos rancheros' (egg 100 g, salsa 128 g, corn tortilla 25 g, oil 4.7 g). It includes a tortilla (~10% by weight) and usually less oil than home shakshuka.
